description: Recommends 5-year tax abatements for 9 affordable housing projects.
This would create 210 new affordable rental units.
Seeks provincial education tax abatements for two specific sites.

chips.text: Total estimated tax abatements are $1.65 million over five years.
86 units will have a 10-year affordability commitment; others 20 years.
More supportive and transitional housing is needed to meet community needs.
New affordable housing incentives will focus on supportive, transitional housing next year.

description: City monitors future redevelopment of Idylwyld Drive Polytechnic campus.
Province plans to relocate the 23.8-acre campus.

chips.text: Saskatchewan Polytechnic and province own the 23.8-acre Idylwyld Drive campus.

description: Hamm Construction seeks to buy municipal reserve land at 134 English Crescent.
Hamm will fund relocating rugby facilities, increasing city's reserve land.

chips.text: Hamm will purchase land at fair market value and fully fund rugby relocation.
Selling municipal reserve land is considered exceptional.
Administration will provide a follow-up report with options for new MR parcels.

description: Saskatoon is developing a framework for preventative community safety.
Targeted community engagement is underway for the framework.
Council expects the full framework by Q2 2027.

chips.text: Engagement targets groups facing significant barriers and access challenges.
